shortDesc.en: Holder's Ground-type attacks have 1.2x power.
shortDesc.zhHans: 手感细腻的沙子。携带后，地面属性的招式威力就会提高。

shortDesc.en: If held by a Latias/Latios, its Dragon- and Psychic-type moves have 1.2x power.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让拉帝欧斯或拉帝亚斯携带后，超能力和龙属性的招式威力就会提高的神奇珠子。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Ghost-type attacks have 1.2x power.
shortDesc.zhHans: 古怪可怕的咒符。携带后，幽灵属性的招式威力就会提高。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Water-type attacks have 1.2x power. Judgment is Water type.
shortDesc.zhHans: 水属性的石板。携带后，水属性的招式威力就会增强。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Ghost-type attacks have 1.2x power. Judgment is Ghost type.
shortDesc.zhHans: 幽灵属性的石板。携带后，幽灵属性的招式威力就会增强。

shortDesc.en: A special Poke Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.
shortDesc.zhHans: 曽在城都地区的捕虫大赛上使用的特殊的球。

shortDesc.en: Raises a random stat by 2 when at 1/4 max HP or less (not acc/eva). Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让宝可梦携带后，危机时，某一项能力就会大幅提高。

shortDesc.en: Evolves Milcery into Alcremie when held and spun around.
shortDesc.zhHans: 星星形状的工艺糖果。让小仙奶携带的话，会高兴地转圈圈。

shortDesc.en: Each turn, holder loses 1/8 max HP. An attacker making contact can receive it.
shortDesc.zhHans: 携带后，每回合都会受到伤害。有时也会附着到碰到自己的对手身上。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Rock-type attacks have 1.2x power. Judgment is Rock type.
shortDesc.zhHans: 岩石属性的石板。携带后，岩石属性的招式威力就会增强。

shortDesc.en: Evolves Milcery into Alcremie when held and spun around.
shortDesc.zhHans: 草莓形状的工艺糖果。让小仙奶携带的话，会高兴地转圈圈。

shortDesc.en: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.
shortDesc.zhHans: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像太阳一样赤红。

desc.en: Evolves Gloom into Bellossom, Sunkern into Sunflora, Cottonee into Whimsicott, Petilil into Lilligant, and Helioptile into Heliolisk when used.
desc.zhHans: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像太阳一样赤红。

shortDesc.en: Evolves Applin into Appletun when used.
shortDesc.zhHans: 这种神奇的苹果可以使特定的宝可梦进化。吃起来非常甜美。

shortDesc.en: Cannot be eaten by the holder. No effect when eaten with Bug Bite or Pluck.
shortDesc.zhHans: 如果把它交给宝可梦，宝可梦就会变得非常容易和训练家亲密，但速度的基础点数会降低。

shortDesc.en: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Bug-type attack. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让宝可梦携带后，在受到效果绝佳的虫属性招式攻击时，能令其威力减弱。

shortDesc.en: Evolves Applin into Flapple when used.
shortDesc.zhHans: 这种神奇的苹果可以使特定的宝可梦进化。吃起来酸酸的。

shortDesc.en: Holder's use of Electric/Grassy/Misty/Psychic Terrain lasts 8 turns instead of 5.
shortDesc.zhHans: 当携带它的宝可梦利用招式或特性展开场地时，场地的持续时间会比平时更长。

shortDesc.en: Raises holder's Special Attack by 1 stage after it uses a sound move. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 使用声音相关的招式时，特攻会提高。

shortDesc.en: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.
shortDesc.zhHans: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。有着闪电般的花纹。

desc.en: Evolves Pikachu into Raichu or Alolan Raichu, Eevee into Jolteon, Eelektrik into Eelektross, and Charjabug into Vikavolt when used.
desc.zhHans: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。有着闪电般的花纹。

shortDesc.en: A Poke Ball that becomes better the more turns there are in a battle.
shortDesc.zhHans: 有点与众不同的球。回合数花费得越多，宝可梦就会越容易捕捉。

shortDesc.en: At the end of every turn, this item attempts to badly poison the holder.
shortDesc.zhHans: 触碰后会放出毒的神奇宝珠。携带后，在战斗时会变成剧毒状态。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Poison-type attacks have 1.2x power. Judgment is Poison type.
shortDesc.zhHans: 毒属性的石板。携带后，毒属性的招式威力就会增强。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Psychic-type attacks have 1.2x power.
shortDesc.zhHans: 注入了念力的汤匙。携带后，超能力属性的招式威力就会提高。

shortDesc.en: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher catch rate than a Great Ball.
shortDesc.zhHans: 比起超级球来更容易捉到宝可梦的，性能非常不错的球。

shortDesc.en: Evolves Porygon into Porygon2 when traded.
shortDesc.zhHans: 内部储存了各种信息的透明机器。西尔佛公司制造。

shortDesc.en: The holder ignores rain- and sun-based effects.
shortDesc.zhHans: 携带它的宝可梦在下雨或日照很强时，不会受到天气的影响。

desc.en: The holder ignores rain- and sun-based effects, including those of its Ability unless it is Orichalcum Pulse or Protosynthesis. Damage and accuracy calculations from attacks used by the holder are affected by rain and sun, but not attacks used against the holder.
desc.zhHans: 携带它的宝可梦在下雨或日照很强时，不会受到天气的影响。

shortDesc.en: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Electric-type attack. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让宝可梦携带后，在受到效果绝佳的电属性招式攻击时，能令其威力减弱。

shortDesc.en: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.
shortDesc.zhHans: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。看上去是澄蓝色的。

desc.en: Evolves Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, Shellder into Cloyster, Staryu into Starmie, Eevee into Vaporeon, Lombre into Ludicolo, and Panpour into Simipour when used.
desc.zhHans: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。看上去是澄蓝色的。

shortDesc.en: If holder is hit super effectively, raises Attack, Sp. Atk by 2 stages. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 被针对弱点时，攻击和特攻就会大幅提高。

shortDesc.en: Ogerpon-Wellspring: 1.2x power attacks; Terastallize to gain Embody Aspect.
shortDesc.zhHans: 厄诡椪-水井携带后招式威力提升20%；太晶化后特性变为面影辉映

shortDesc.en: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 当携带它的宝可梦能力降低时，仅能回到之前的状态１次。

shortDesc.en: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1x.
shortDesc.zhHans: 能放大观看物体的镜片。携带后，招式的命中率就会少量提高。

shortDesc.en: Restores 1/3 max HP at 1/4 max HP or less; confuses if -SpA Nature. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让宝可梦携带后，危机时可以回复ＨＰ。如果讨厌这味道就会混乱。

shortDesc.en: Holder's special attacks have 1.1x power.
shortDesc.zhHans: 装着很厚镜片的眼镜。携带后，特殊招式的威力就会少量提高。

shortDesc.en: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ice-type attack. Single use.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让宝可梦携带后，在受到效果绝佳的冰属性招式攻击时，能令其威力减弱。

shortDesc.en: Holder's Electric-type attacks have 1.2x power. Judgment is Electric type.
shortDesc.zhHans: 电属性的石板。携带后，电属性的招式威力就会增强。

shortDesc.en: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.2x if it moves after its target.
shortDesc.zhHans: 当携带它的宝可梦比对手行动迟缓时，招式会变得容易命中。
